cards.feature: Resource bookings on an editable timeline

cards.title: One plan, three windows
cards.feature: A Scheduler booking, Gantt task and board card share one record across windows.

cards.title: A year for 300 people
cards.feature: 300 people and 15,600 seeded bookings across a 52-week timeline

cards.title: Re-plan a day by drag
cards.feature: Bookings that move between resources, stretch, and snap to a grid you choose

cards.title: Weekends and holidays in the plan
cards.feature: Non-working days and dates shaded across the timeline and its header

cards.title: Bars that say more
cards.feature: Progress inside each bar, and a renderer that colours by status and adds a second line

cards.title: Edit a booking in a form
cards.feature: A booking's editor: title, room, start and end, with a minimum length

cards.title: Zoom from hours to a week
cards.feature: Three zoom levels over the same bookings, each with its own time axis and snap

cards.title: A table beside the timeline
cards.feature: Four locked resource columns: name, skill, region and booked hours, each sortable

cards.title: One plan, three time zones
cards.feature: The same shifts read in Berlin, New York or Tokyo time

cards.title: A plan that updates itself
cards.feature: Flights arrive, slip and leave on a simulated feed while you scroll and drag

cards.title: Community Garden Plan
cards.feature: A project plan with linked, editable tasks

cards.title: One plan, three windows
cards.feature: A Scheduler booking, Gantt task and board card share one record across windows.

cards.title: A project of 2,000 tasks
cards.feature: A seeded building programme: 2,000 tasks in phases and zones, linked by 1,972 dependencies

cards.title: Zoom a plan in and out
cards.feature: The same linked plan at more than one scale, its links re-drawn at each

cards.title: Durations in working days
cards.feature: Tasks that skip weekends and holidays when they compute their end

cards.title: Link tasks by drag
cards.feature: Dependencies drawn from one task's handle to another, in four link types

cards.title: Edit a task in a form
cards.feature: A task's editor: title, start, end and percent done, and a plan that follows the change

cards.title: Your columns beside the plan
cards.feature: Seven task columns: outline number, tree, owner, dates, days and a progress bar

cards.title: A late task moves the plan
cards.feature: One task slips, and every task that depends on it follows to its new date

cards.title: A plan's release gates
cards.feature: Six diamond milestones mark the phase gates of a launch, linked task to gate to task

cards.title: An exhibition takes shape
cards.feature: Each phase takes its dates and progress from its tasks.
